confirmatory_rule.missing_data: If a run fails operationally, retry once with identical cell identity; the attempt is logged. A seed with a missing trained/frozen pair member is dropped from that cell's paired test (predeclared; never outcome-based).
confirmatory_rule.pairing: per-seed paired contrast trained vs frozen_random within block pb-conf-{seed}

primary_family.confirm_if: p < alpha_per_cell AND mean G_R >= threshold AND persistence
primary_family.description: H1 at the two headline cells selected by the P1 go rule
primary_family.persistence: mean G_R > 0 at eval steps 1800, 1900, and 2000

privacy_criterion.h5_support_if: any primary-confirmed cell also has advantage <= threshold

secondary_family.description: remaining surface cells and span x width interaction
secondary_family.sensitivity: wilcoxon_signed_rank per primary cell, reported not gated

note: Confirmatory analysis under protocol p2-confirmatory-1.0 (frozen 2026-09-04, fresh seeds [11..88]); per docs/PREREGISTRATION.md.

long-high.note: normal approximation with continuity correction; n=8 is small, interpret with care

medium-high.note: normal approximation with continuity correction; n=8 is small, interpret with care
